newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Randgold confirms gold mine merger plan.
newsitem.headline: Randgold confirms gold mine merger plan.

text.p: Randgold and Exploration Co Ltd confirmed on Wednesday that its Durban Roodepoort Deep Ltd unit was considering making an offer for Blyvooruitzicht Gold Mining Co Ltd and Buffelsfontein Gold Mines Ltd.
Details of the proposed transaction, which would represent a rationalisation of Randgold's interests on the West Rand, will be annnounced shortly, the company said.
Randgold cautioned shareholders last Friday that certain proposals were being considered with regard the three gold mines, prompting market speculation of merger.
Analysts say merging the mines was in line with Randgold's philosophy of rationalising mining areas and creating economies of scale.
The planned three-mine merger follows in the footsteps of Randgold's Harmony Gold Mining Co Ltd's bid for Grootvlei Proprietary Mines Ltd.
